gravelminer.configuration.title: GravelMiner
gravelminer.configuration.common.gravelB: Blocks that will fall and break into items when hitting a non-solid block. Format: modid:name
gravelminer.configuration.common.trigger: If set to true, the mod will trigger when mining gravel as well, instead of only when mining a non-gravel block below gravel.
gravelminer.configuration.common.isOptIn: If set to true, GravelMiner will only be active for users who install the mod on their clients (for use in servers).
gravelminer.configuration.client.isEnabl: Whether GravelMiner is currently enabled for this client (toggled via keybind)
gravelminer.configuration.client.activat: Defines when GravelMiner should activate. Either ALWAYS, WHEN_SNEAKING or WHEN_NOT_SNEAKING
